page.overview:
Who is Bo-Ro-Tara?

Bo-Ro-Tara was the President of Cerea during the Clone Wars. President Bo-Ro-Tara was in office when war erupted on his homeworld in a battle that would last for a month. The Battle of Cerea ended with Bo-Ro-Tara's assassination at the hands of Gossam Commandos.
